composition.rule: The exact decoded P1344 capsule baseline at its protected hash supplies every capsule record, ID, order, file, owner, anchor, replacement, cfg, marker, normalization and restriction. P1345 changes none of them; it may add only a separately authoritative canonical full-token production table after contract authorship.
composition.manifest_validation: PASS: 38 unique IDs, 12 unique files and exact per-file concatenation
composition.new_anchor_validation: PASS: 4/4 P1344 owner-local anchors occur exactly once in current candidate-free bytes

normalization.source: the exact normalization algorithm and replacement bytes in protected P1344 baseline
normalization.required_result: removing/replacing all 38 future marked regions in descending live byte offset must recover the 12 exact complete file hashes in file_baselines
normalization.candidate_control: none; candidate-declared hashes, paths, anchors, owners and normalized bytes are untrusted

parser_fit.command: rustfmt --edition 2021 <three complete copied consumers containing one inert associated-method probe each>

restrictions: No topology, capsule, owner, anchor, replacement or normalization override is authorized by P1345.
The canonical full-token table is a future oracle-author artifact and cannot be supplied by a candidate.
No thirteenth consumer, public API, default behavior, compatibility or pipeline phase change.
Unknown, absent or conflicting inherited data is Violated, never Preserved.
scope: Candidate-free capsule topology only; no canonical candidate tokens, contract, oracle, runtime, seal or implementation verdict.

closed_world.rule: Exactly these top-level keys are valid. Duplicate keys, P1344 input drift or any implicit topology override invalidates this baseline.
